stacking.note: No hardware stacking. A FortiGate manages 8 to 300 switches (model dependent) as one fabric with automatic inter-switch links

routing.summary: Layer 2. The data sheet lists no hardware routing on these models; routing is done on the FortiGate

power.summary: External DC power into redundant input terminals; no internal PSU. Optional Fortinet DIN rail PSUs (SP-RGDIN-240-PS, SP-RGDIN-480-PS, sold in pairs)

redundancy.detail: Two DC input terminals for redundant feeds; the DC supplies are external and sold separately

licensing: No license needed when managed by a FortiGate over FortiLink. Cloud (FortiManagement Cloud) or FortiSwitchNMS management is a separate subscription

models.note: Rated -40 to 65C in a sealed enclosure, 70C vented (0.2 m/s), 75C with forced air (1 m/s). DC input +/-12 to +/-57V
PoE needs a +/-44V or higher DC feed (52V or higher for 802.3bt). Rated -40 to 65C sealed, 70C vented, 75C with forced air
PoE derates with temperature: 360W up to 60C, 240W up to 75C. Fortinet's ordering text calls this a layer 2/3 switch, but the specifications table lists no hardware routing; modeled as Layer 2
